what: Amer Sports owns premium sports brands: Arc'teryx outdoor clothing, Salomon footwear and ski equipment, Wilson racquets and balls, and Atomic skis. Arc'teryx is the main growth engine.
customers: Outdoor, ski, running and racquet sport consumers worldwide, through its own stores, website and specialist retailers.
money: Salomon footwear, ski equipment and Atomic
Wilson tennis, golf and team sports
moat: Arc'teryx has become a genuinely aspirational brand with its own stores and almost no discounting, which is rare and hard for a competitor to manufacture.
risks: Growth depends heavily on one brand, Arc'teryx
Chinese consumer demand is a large and volatile part of its growth
Premium outdoor clothing is discretionary spending
opportunities: Revenue grew about 27% last year and about 23% a year over three years
Analysts see large upside, with a median target well above the current price
Direct-to-consumer stores earn far more per item than wholesale
watch: Arc'teryx revenue growth and the direct-to-consumer share of sales.
